candidate_host_mapping.mapping: At a context boundary, scan eligible visible observations owned by the package, group them by solver-call metadata as donor-style interaction groups, keep the most recent configured groups unchanged, and issue one project_observations effect that rewrites older groups to a fixed compaction marker.

reason: Frozen mapping permits only observations owned by this package. It declares only project_observations, which replaces existing observations and cannot create its own initial observations. Real entry installs only C; ordinary solver tool outputs retain owner host. Selecting host observations or adding an observation producer changes the frozen mapping/capabilities.
